method.class: Cold-start benchmark-subset selection plus score imputation (regularized regression / low-rank matrix completion) on a historical model x benchmark score matrix with missing cells
method.description: The candidate receives an anonymous history matrix (M models x N benchmarks, missing cells masked) through chunked RPC, commits to k benchmark indices before seeing any new-model score (non-adaptive), then predicts the scores of held-out new models on all N benchmarks from their observed scores on the k selected ones. Scored by evaluator-held truth as RMSE in historical-column-std units (equal weight per held-out model) against column-mean imputation, evaluator-seeded random-k ridge and greedy-forward-selection ridge baselines, with evaluator-owned permuted/constant negative controls. Bounded claim: lower held-out error than history-only column-mean imputation and than random-k selection with the same imputer, as an empirical error-vs-k curve, on family-group-disjoint held-out models of the three pinned leaderboards only.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility: correct is true (all 12 declared episodes completed incl. permuted and constant controls with valid committed-before-observation selections and finite predictions, evaluator baselines finite, controls non-vacuous, and mean real-input nRMSE strictly below permuted-control nRMSE at matched k=10) and combined_score finite; beating baselines is not an eligibility gate. The harness ranks eligible candidates by higher combined_score (ties within 1e-9 go to the earlier evaluation), freezes the single best eligible candidate after at most 3 cycles x 1 evaluation before any final resource is available, and makes no final claim if none is eligible. Final correct is stated separately: integrity (all 42 declared episodes complete, controls non-vacuous and real-input nRMSE strictly below permuted at every family control and below the MTEB constant control) AND final_score > 0 AND final_skill_vs_random_selection > 0 (strict, no margin); greedy-ridge comparison, per-family and per-k results are reported but not gated.

required_evidence: Payload preflight: serialized UTF-8 JSON byte counts (incl. base64 expansion, mask, metadata, envelope, newline framing) of the largest history chunk, predict request and predict response for each family, all strictly below the 64 MiB wire limit; chunk/batch protocol; exact max_candidate_rpc_calls arithmetic (search 130 = 12 episodes x (1 reset + <=4 history chunks + 1 select + <=4 predict batches) + one permitted trailing replay of 10; final 406 = 3 seeds x (6 MTEB x 10 + 4 OLL x 12 + 4 HELM x 6) + replay 10) with no shared file paths in any RPC

Reset transcript conformance: broker-visible reset transcripts equal search_reset_sequence and final_reset_sequence in order; smoke transcripts [11,11] and [201,201]; seeds only randomize candidates; trailing replay (if run) of the first seed only

Split and leakage evidence: fixed model-name normalization, normalized SHA-256 content-hash and family-group manifests with zero overlap between search and final and between history and held-out in every family, row provenance (upstream path and pinned revision), seeds and split manifests; no final seeds, final data, model names or held-out values in search-visible starter code or RPC payloads

Evaluator-owned baseline results (column mean, random-k ridge, greedy-forward ridge) on identical held-out cells and k, evaluator-owned negative controls (fixed-point-free permutation of held-out observations; constant column-mean observations) with expected behavior real < control, paired candidate-vs-baseline comparison with strict-inequality tie policy, retained worst-case contributions for failed/missing episodes, and bootstrap CIs over held-out models clustered by family group per dataset and per k

Separate statements of scientific validity, search eligibility/ranking/freeze, and final claim assessment; explicit labelling that search (MTEB-style only) is a proxy for final (MTEB-style + OLL + HELM Lite) and that the claim is restricted to those pinned leaderboards, family-disjoint held-out models and the evaluated k grids, with the empirical error-vs-k curve as the only answer to how large k must be

Compute-limit accounting separating enforced limits (wall-clock deadline, broker RPC cap, per-episode deadlines, role-local CPU allocation) from advisory candidate-internal counts, plus per-plane wall-clock usage covering setup, baselines, episodes and cleanup; reduced smoke does not attest production completion

Reproducibility package per task.md deliverable: pinned requirements.txt, upstream revisions and artifact SHA-256 values synchronized in task_contract.json, run commands, seeds and expected runtimes; every number, table and figure regenerated by shipped code; failed or unfinished experiments reported as such
